dreamteamer.title: Projects
dreamteamer.description: The plan and everyone in it: projects, decisions, deliverables, risks and teams. The work itself is planned as `tasks` (the tasks module); a project is the effort they hang off. Owners and leads point at `users`, outside parties at `contacts`. `bin/check-records.mjs` enforces what a schema cannot.
